### Company establishes offtake pathways across all three primary Project Headwaters ARC product streams and reduces third quarter operating expenses approximately 19% year over year


RENO, Nev., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aqua Metals, Inc. (NASDAQ: AQMS), a pioneer in sustainable lithium battery recycling, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided a business update.


**Strategic and Commercial Progress**


“The third quarter was about converting commercial discussions into agreements and lowering the cost of carrying the business while we advance the funding strategy for Project Headwaters ARC,” said Steve Cotton, President and Chief Executive Officer of Aqua Metals. “We now have letters of intent covering all three primary product streams. Copper and aluminum come from our Phase 1 preprocessing operation, and lithium carbonate from our Phase 2 AquaRefining operation. We also brought third quarter operating expenses down approximately 19% from a year ago, and the cost-reduction plan we have put in place targets further reductions over the coming months.


“The policy environment for domestic battery recycling has moved quickly this year. On July 30, the Administration issued a presidential determination intended to prioritize domestic recovery of critical minerals, and on August 6 the Bureau of Industry and Security issued a rule restricting exports of battery black mass. Roughly eight weeks later, one-year waivers to that rule began to be publicly announced, which leaves the longer-term direction of policy unclear. That uncertainty has made investors and financing partners more cautious about committing capital to domestic battery recycling projects, and we have planned around it. We continue to pursue the phased deployment strategy for Project Headwaters ARC that we described last quarter, with the timing of each phase dependent on securing the necessary financing and commercial commitments. In parallel, we are evaluating strategic alternatives intended to preserve shareholder value and position the Company for future opportunities.


“We end the quarter with offtake pathways across all three primary product streams, a better-defined Phase 1 project and a lower cost base. Each of those puts Aqua Metals in a better position to act as funding and policy conditions become clearer.”


**Offtake Pathways Established Across Primary Product Streams**


During the quarter, Aqua Metals established offtake pathways covering all three primary Project Headwaters ARC product streams.


- **Copper and aluminum:** On September 14, 2026, the Company announced a five-year letter of intent with a leading Midwest metals recycler contemplating the purchase of up to 100% of the commercially saleable copper and aluminum expected to be produced at Project Headwaters ARC. The letter of intent provides a 24-month period to negotiate and execute a definitive offtake agreement, with product qualification based on representative material produced by the Project Headwaters ARC preprocessing system.


- **Lithium carbonate:** On August 31, 2026, the Company announced a non-binding six-year letter of intent with WMC Group AG covering 100% of the planned lithium carbonate output from Phase 2 of Project Headwaters ARC. The letter of intent provides for market-indexed pricing and contemplates collaboration on feedstock sourcing, tolling and product qualification.


Each letter of intent is non-binding, and there can be no assurance that the Company will enter into definitive agreements with either counterparty or that anticipated production volumes or values will be achieved.


**Project Headwaters ARC Development Progress**


- **Site diligence:** completed facility inspections and a Phase I environmental site assessment as part of the due diligence process for the proposed Project Headwaters ARC facility.
- **Permitting:** engaged state and local regulatory and planning authorities and submitted a written permitting pathway outlining required permits, responsible agencies, dependencies and anticipated timelines.
- **Economic development:** received a written offer from state and local economic development partners outlining up to approximately $2.27 million in potential workforce training support and tax savings, subject to program requirements and approvals.
- **Engineering:** advanced preliminary facility engineering with third-party engineering consultants and design-build contractors, including equipment layouts, process integration, utility requirements, and fire and life safety design. Received capital cost estimates from multiple design-build contractors and preprocessing equipment proposals from equipment suppliers, providing greater definition of the Phase 1 project scope.
- **Capital deployment:** the Company continues to pursue project equity, equipment financing, real estate financing and government incentives to support Project Headwaters ARC.


Project timing and scope remain subject to financing, commercial agreements, permitting, engineering and Board approval.


**Technology and Product Development**


During the quarter, Aqua Metals improved process efficiency and product purity through continued development of its lithium iron phosphate recycling process, including the production of high-purity iron phosphate samples submitted for independent assay testing. The Company also completed the sale of battery-grade lithium carbonate produced at its Innovation Center through its AquaRefining technology to a battery materials company at the prevailing Shanghai Metals Market battery-grade lithium carbonate benchmark price, without discount. The amount was not material to the Company’s financial results, and the proceeds were recorded as a reduction of operating costs.


**Cash Preservation and Capital Strategy**


Aqua Metals has developed a cost-reduction plan encompassing staffing, outside services, discretionary spending and facility costs. The plan is designed to preserve liquidity and align the Company’s cost structure with its near-term priorities. Third quarter operating expenses declined approximately 19% from the prior-year period, and the Company is targeting an additional reduction of approximately 35% in monthly cash operating costs, which it expects to realize over the coming months as the plan is implemented. The Board of Directors has also formed a Transaction Committee to evaluate strategic alternatives available to the Company. There can be no assurance that this evaluation will result in any transaction, and the Company does not intend to comment further unless and until the Board of Directors has approved a specific course of action or the Company otherwise determines that disclosure is appropriate or required.


**Conference Call and Webcast**


Aqua Metals will host a conference call and webcast to discuss these results at 4:30 p.m. ET on Monday, November 16, 2026.


The live conference call and replay can be accessed from the investor relations section of the Company’s website at[https://ir.aquametals.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=XV4ETN11LlW8TDcdn5jB_odn9HyHRkTLKhLJbFVisBsmHBhG1G8GWRDXDZWKOixvx3XLmRUCLAXqDNrVLmWYFNuo8gVhK9ZsjUveHknq5K4=) .


**About Aqua Metals**


Aqua Metals is advancing sustainable lithium battery recycling through its proprietary AquaRefining™ technology, an electro-hydrometallurgical process designed to recover critical battery materials using electricity rather than high-temperature processing. The Company is developing Project Headwaters as its first commercial-scale deployment focused on domestic recycling and refining of lithium-ion batteries and manufacturing scrap.
